workflow.name: Shift handover
workflow.description: At 07:00 and 19:00 UTC, gathers the alerts created over the last 12 hours, the open alerts and the open cases, and has the AI write the handover for the incoming shift: a headline, what happened, what to do first and what to watch. The full handover with the numbers lands in the AI suggestions inbox and the workflow owner is notified: set the notify node to the shift. Without an AI provider, the numbers are still sent. Adjust the cron and the "created:>now-12h" query of the first node to your shifts.
